description: Attaches a lead form to a destination connection by creating a list. Send mapping AND settings in this same call: a NEW list immediately replays up to 7 days of that form's leads using the mapping given here, so mapping afterwards delivers the replay unmapped. Idempotent on page, form and connection (an existing list comes back with created false, mapping_applied false and a hint; its mapping is untouched). form_id "catch_all" catches every form on the page; Google Sheets needs settings.sheet_id, the TAB NAME. Gated: on another account, or a live form, wait for the human's yes first. override_limits is admin-only and audited.

account_id.description: Admin keys only: the LeadSync account (user id, integer or digit string) to act on; overrides LEADSYNC_ACCOUNT

form_id.description: Meta lead form id as a digit string, or "catch_all" for every form on the page

mapping.description: Lead field key to destination field, e.g. {"first_name":"First name","phone_number":"Phone"}. Keys are lead keys as delivered (first_name, last_name, full_name, email, phone_number, custom question keys (forms[].questions[].key from refresh_forms), created_at, leadgen_id, platform, form_id, form_name, page_id, page_name, ad_account_id, ad_account_name; Google Sheets also leadsync:campaign_name, leadsync:adset_name, leadsync:ad_name). Values are destination field names exactly as get_destination_fields returns them. Replaces any existing mapping

override_limits.description: Admin keys with write access only: skip account and plan limits (audited)

page_id.description: LeadSync page id or Facebook page id (digit string; send it as a string, Meta ids exceed JavaScript safe integers)

existed.description: What to do when the contact already exists in the destination

sheet_id.description: Google Sheets only: the exact TAB NAME inside the spreadsheet, not the spreadsheet id. Ask the human for it (new Google Sheets often use "Sheet1", but a sheet created another way may be "Untitled")

name: attach_form
